result.description: Email marketing and automation platform (Intuit Mailchimp) with audiences, campaigns, automations, reports and e-commerce via the Marketing API.
result.auth_detail: Per-account API key (Basic with any username, or Bearer) for own account; OAuth2 authorization-code flow via Registered Apps to act on behalf of other Mailchimp users. Datacenter-specific base URL.
result.access_detail: Docs state OAuth 2 needs only "A Mailchimp account" and app registration via "Register An App" in Registered Apps; no review/approval/publishing step or paid plan is documented. Users with Manager permissions can generate their own API keys. A Free plan (under 250 contacts) exists; docs do not restrict API to paid plans (not explicitly confirmed for Free plan; pricing page does not mention API gating). Note: new API keys expire after 1 year from June 22, 2026.
result.api_notes: Marketing API v3.0 REST at https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/ covering lists/audiences, members, campaigns, automations, reports, templates, e-commerce, etc.; plus separate Transactional (Mandrill) API. Official SDKs exist (TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, etc.).

evidence.quote: Authorization using a Mailchimp API key (a.k.a. Bearer token)
This page walks through implementing OAuth 2 so your application can access the Marketing API on behalf of other Mailchimp users.
Users with Manager permissions can generate their own API keys.
The root url for the API is `https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/`.
This searches documentation, not your Mailchimp account.
